description: React and TypeScript components for dense interfaces such as toolbars, data tables, menus, inspectors and app shells. Built on Base UI and distributed as a shadcn registry: the shadcn CLI copies each component's source into the project.
rules: Keyline is a shadcn registry, not an npm package: add items with the shadcn CLI (npx shadcn@latest add @keyline-ui/<name>), never npm install.
Keyline requires React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4 and a shadcn project with a components.json.
Import installed components from @/components/keyline/ui/<name>, for example import { Button } from "@/components/keyline/ui/button".
